column5: CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('M_', yyyymmdd) =1 THEN  'SUM(CASE WHEN yyyymm   = RIGHT('''+yyyymmdd+''',6) THEN CONVERT(BIGINT,QTY) END ) AS ' + yyyymmdd

WHEN CHARINDEX('D_', yyyymmdd) =1 THEN  'SUM(CASE WHEN yyyymmdd = '''+yyyymmdd+''' THEN CONVERT(BIGINT,QTY) END ) AS ' + yyyymmdd
